name: comfyui-filename-prefix
description: Build filename_prefix from live workflow variables, or pick from saved presets. TypeScript source in src/, built to web/dist/ via bun build. The @laurigates/comfy-modal-kit primitives are inlined by bun build. See ADR-0001.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --target browser --format esm --banner '/* web/dist bundle built by bun from src/ in this repository (see package.json). Inlines @laurigates/comfy-modal-kit (MIT) - a first-party library by the same publisher, published to npm with provenance attestation: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@laurigates/comfy-modal-kit */' --outdir web/dist --external '/scripts/*'
